extDescription.message: Hand browser downloads over to the local Vexto app

errHostLoopback.message: Only loopback addresses are allowed: 127.0.0.1 or localhost.

errPortRange.message: The port must be an integer between 1024 and 65535.

errMinSize.message: The minimum size must be a number of 0 or greater (MB).

errDupWindow.message: The duplicate protection window must be an integer of 0 or greater (seconds).

errTimeout.message: Connection timed out: $TARGET$ did not respond within $SECONDS$ seconds. Vexto may be stuck, or another program is using the port.

errConnect.message: Cannot connect to $TARGET$: Vexto is not running or the port is not listening (connection refused). Make sure Vexto runs in the tray and extension takeover is enabled.

http401.message: Secret key mismatch (401): make sure the extension and Vexto use exactly the same add-on key; both being empty also counts as a match.

http403.message: Request rejected (403): Vexto does not accept this request origin or client identifier.

http404.message: Endpoint not found (404): the service on this port may not be Vexto, or Vexto is too old.

http426.message: Incompatible protocol (426): upgrade Vexto or the extension.

vextoTrayHint.message: Vexto must be running in the tray

liveUsesSaved.message: Live status uses the saved settings

cardApiDesc.message: The local API of the Vexto tray app. The extension only accesses loopback addresses.

secretPlaceholder.message: Optional; match the value in Vexto

secretHint.message: Must match the add-on key in Vexto; if Vexto has a key and the extension's is empty or different, Vexto returns 401.

cardAutoDesc.message: http/https downloads in the browser are offered to Vexto first; if that fails, the browser download resumes.

autoHint.message: Save to apply changes; on by default. If another download-taking extension is installed, enable auto takeover in only one of them.

cardDownloadListDesc.message: Controls whether Edge shows the download bar / bubble. This is a global switch.

cardContextMenuDesc.message: If you prefer not to take over automatically, you can hand individual links to Vexto.

contextMenuHint.message: Right-click a link on a page and choose "Download with Vexto"; if Vexto is unavailable, the browser download is used and the reason is shown.

cardForwardDesc.message: Which request details are passed along on hand-off.

forwardHeadersHint.message: When off, /add does not carry referer or userAgent.

cardFilterDesc.message: Applies only to automatic takeover; "Download with Vexto" from the context menu is not affected.

unknownSizeLabel.message: Take over even when the size is unknown

dupWindowHint.message: In seconds; 0 = off. The same URL + filename is handed to Vexto only once within this window.

cardSitesDesc.message: Matches domain suffixes: example.com also matches sub.example.com. Lines starting with # are comments.

allowSitesLabel.message: Only take over these domains (one per line; empty = all)

blockSitesLabel.message: Never take over these domains (one per line)

cardDiagDesc.message: Records only hand-off outcomes and host names — never URL query strings, cookies or keys. Up to 50 entries, kept for the browser session only.

diagEmpty.message: No diagnostic events yet. After you enable automatic takeover and download something, entries appear here.

cookieHintOff.message: Off by default. When enabled, your login state is handed to the local Vexto; the first enable requires all-site cookie permission.

cookieHintGranted.message: All-site cookie access granted (read only while enabled, sent only to the local Vexto).

cookieHintUngranted.message: All-site cookie access not granted yet: saving asks for it. Without it, cookie forwarding stays off.

downloadUiHintOff.message: When on, the download list/bubble is hidden only while a takeover is attempted and reappears if the download falls back to the browser. The first enable requires the download UI permission.

downloadUiHintGranted.message: Granted: the download list is hidden during takeover attempts and restored afterwards.

downloadUiHintUngranted.message: Download UI permission not granted yet: saving asks for it. Without it, the download list is not hidden.

paneConnectionDesc.message: Configure the local Vexto API and see the live connection status.

paneAutoDesc.message: Hand browser downloads to Vexto and resume the browser download if that fails.

paneTransferDesc.message: Control what is passed along on hand-off and the filters for automatic takeover.

paneSitesDesc.message: Decide which downloads go to Vexto by domain.

paneDiagDesc.message: Review recent hand-off results and diagnose failures.

notVextoPing.message: The service on this port did not return a Vexto version.

versionUnrecognized.message: The /version response from Vexto is not recognized.

liveEngineOffReason.message: Vexto is connected but its download engine is disabled; hand-offs fall back to the browser download.

settingsNotSaved.message: Settings not saved: fix the highlighted fields.

cookieDeniedNotice.message: All-site cookie access was not granted, so cookie forwarding is off;

downloadUiDeniedNotice.message: Download UI permission was not granted, so hiding the download list is off;

cannotTest.message: Cannot test: fix the highlighted fields first.

pingMissingVersion.message: The service on this port is not Vexto: the /ping response has no version field.

connectedEngineOff.message: Connected · Vexto $VERSION$ · engine disabled ($ENGINE$): hand-offs fall back to the browser download$PROTOCOL$

cookieDeniedStatus.message: All-site cookie access was not granted.

downloadUiDeniedStatus.message: Download UI permission was not granted.

popupDisabledReason.message: Enable the extension in settings to start taking over downloads.

popupEngineUnknownReason.message: Connected to Vexto, but the engine status could not be read.

noLinkReason.message: Make sure you right-clicked on a link.

unsupportedLinkReason.message: Only http/https links can be handed to Vexto.

extDisabledReason.message: Enable the extension in the Vexto Connect options page and try again.

fellBackHeadline.message: Fell back to the browser download

rejectedReasonLong.message: Vexto refused the request: the download engine is disabled or this link type is not supported.

usedBrowserDownload.message: The browser download is used instead.

browserDownloadFailed.message: The browser download could not be started either: $DETAIL$. Copy the link and download it manually.

noResponseRestored.message: Vexto did not respond; the browser download was resumed

secretMismatchRestored.message: Secret key mismatch; the browser download was resumed

httpStatusRestored.message: Vexto returned HTTP $STATUS$; the browser download was resumed

handedOffNotCanceled.message: Handed off to Vexto, but the browser download was not canceled

autoTakeoverError.message: Auto takeover failed; the browser download was resumed

rejectedReasonShort.message: Vexto refused the request (the download engine is disabled or the link type is unsupported).
